# Justin Grant, Senior UX Designer

> Senior UX designer for complex web products, from first research to shipped features. Prototyping, design systems, accessibility (WCAG), and research with readers, learners, and open-source communities. Work across open-source AI, publishing, education, and enterprise tools.

Website: https://justingrant.design/
Contact: https://justingrant.design/#contact
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/justgrant5/
